reply_text:
Installed GBrain 0.60.757.0 using the documented standalone-release route, pinned to your requested version.

  CLI: /harness-state/.local/bin/gbrain
  Database: /harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite
  Source: default

Your existing identity and instructions were preserved. Setup appended a marked brain-first instruction block and registered GBrain with Hermes.

Keyless settings:
  Keyword retrieval enabled; embeddings disabled.
  Automatic writeback and conversation archiving off.
  No paid providers, scheduled jobs, or background services installed.
  Free session-idle upkeep remains on.

Verification:
  remember saved synthetic marker amber-orchid-728c5c9b as fact #1, with provenance install-check.
  Separate recall processes returned that exact fact.
  Keyword search returned the verification page with evidence keyword_exact.
  Hermes MCP connected and discovered 8 tools.
  Hermes’s hook diagnostic passed.

Caveat: GBrain setup reported a hook-detection failure despite Hermes’s successful diagnostic. Its wiring doctor also failed to recognize the harness. A fresh Hermes conversation test timed out, so cross-conversation activation is not yet verified. The synthetic marker remains for that check.

Search-mode choice

Conservative is currently applied: 4K-token budget, 10 chunks, no reranker. Alternatives are balanced (12K budget, 25 chunks) and tokenmax (uncapped budget, 50 chunks). Changing modes does not authorize paid providers.

Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.

These are GBrain’s illustrative downstream-model estimates, not your harness subscription pricing. You can choose any mode; conservative remains active meanwhile.

Restart Hermes, then ask it to recall the GBrain installation-check marker without supplying the marker text. That remaining check should precede forgetting test fact #1.
